<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

# `google/mcp`

<a href="#googlemcp" id="user-content-googlemcp" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: google/mcp"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

This repository contains a list of Google's official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, guidance on how to deploy MCP servers to Google Cloud, and examples to get started.

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

## ⚡ Google MCP Servers

<a href="#-google-mcp-servers" id="user-content--google-mcp-servers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: ⚡ Google MCP Servers"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

### **Remote MCP servers**

<a href="#remote-mcp-servers" id="user-content-remote-mcp-servers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Remote MCP servers"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

These <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/overview" rel="nofollow">remote MCP servers are managed by Google</a>, and are available <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/enable-disable-mcp-servers" rel="nofollow">via endpoint</a>. Below are a few key remote servrs. For a comprehensive list of all remote MCP servers managed by Google in General Availability (GA) and public preview <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/supported-products" rel="nofollow"><strong>vist the supported products pager</strong></a>

- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/alloydb/docs/ai/use-alloydb-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>AlloyDB for PostgreSQL</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/use-bigquery-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>BigQuery</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigtable/docs/use-bigtable-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Bigtable</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/resource-manager/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud Resource Manager</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/sql/docs/mysql/use-cloudsql-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud SQL for MySQL</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/sql/docs/postgres/use-cloudsql-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/sql/docs/sqlserver/use-cloudsql-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud SQL for SQL Server</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Compute Engine (GCE)</strong></a>
- <a href="https://developers.google.com/knowledge/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Developer Knowledge API (Google Developer Documentation)</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/firestore/native/docs/use-firestore-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Firestore</strong></a>
- <a href="https://developers.google.com/maps/ai/grounding-lite" rel="nofollow"><strong>Google Maps (Grounding Lite)</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/chronicle/docs/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Google Security Operations (Chronicle)</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Kubernetes Engine (GKE)</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/spanner/docs/use-spanner-mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Spanner</strong></a>
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud Run</strong></a> (GA)
- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/reference/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Cloud Storage</strong></a>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

### **Open-source MCP servers**

<a href="#open-source-mcp-servers" id="user-content-open-source-mcp-servers" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Open-source MCP servers"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

You can run these open-source MCP servers locally, or deploy them to Google Cloud (see below).

- [**Google Workspace**](https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/workspace), including Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, Calendar, and Gmail. (Gemini CLI extension)
- [**Firebase**](https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/firebase/) (Gemini CLI extension)
- [**Cloud Run**](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/cloud-run-mcp) (Gemini CLI Extension)
- <a href="https://go.dev/gopls/features/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Go</strong></a>
- [**Google Analytics**](https://github.com/googleanalytics/google-analytics-mcp)
- [**MCP Toolbox for Databases**](https://github.com/googleapis/genai-toolbox), including BigQuery, Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, Firestore, and more.
- [**Google Cloud Storage**](https://github.com/googleapis/gcloud-mcp/tree/main/packages/storage-mcp)
- [**Genmedia**](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/vertex-ai-creative-studio/tree/main/experiments/mcp-genmedia), including Imagen and Veo models.
- [**Kubernetes Engine (GKE)**](https://github.com/GoogleCloudPlatform/gke-mcp)
- [**Google Cloud Security**](https://github.com/google/mcp-security), including Security Command Center, Chronicle, and more.
- [**gcloud CLI**](https://github.com/googleapis/gcloud-mcp/tree/main/packages/gcloud-mcp)
- [**Google Cloud Observability**](https://github.com/googleapis/gcloud-mcp/tree/main/packages/observability-mcp)
- [**Flutter/Dart**](https://github.com/dart-lang/ai/tree/main/pkgs/dart_mcp_server)
- <a href="https://developers.google.com/maps/ai/mcp" rel="nofollow"><strong>Google Maps Platform Code Assist toolkit</strong></a>
- [**Chrome DevTools**](https://github.com/ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp)

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

## 💻 Examples

<a href="#-examples" id="user-content--examples" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 💻 Examples"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

- [**Launch My Bakery**](http://github.com/google/mcp/tree/main/examples/launchmybakery) (`/examples/launchmybakery`)**:** A sample agent built with Agent Development Kit (ADK) that uses remote MCP servers for Google Maps and BigQuery.
- [**Allstrides**](https://github.com/google/mcp/tree/main/examples/allstrides) (`/examples/allstrides`)**:** A sample app migrated from local to Cloud using remote MCP servers for Developer Knowledge, Cloud SQL and Cloud Run

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

## 📙 Resources

<a href="#-resources" id="user-content--resources" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 📙 Resources"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

### **Run an MCP server in Google Cloud**

<a href="#run-an-mcp-server-in-google-cloud" id="user-content-run-an-mcp-server-in-google-cloud" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Run an MCP server in Google Cloud"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

- <a href="https://docs.cloud.google.com/run/docs/host-mcp-servers" rel="nofollow">Documentation - Host MCP Servers on Cloud Run</a>
- Blog Post - <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/build-and-deploy-a-remote-mcp-server-to-google-cloud-run-in-under-10-minutes" rel="nofollow">Build and Deploy a Remote MCP Server to Google Cloud Run in Under 10 Minutes</a>
- <a href="https://googleapis.github.io/genai-toolbox/how-to/deploy_toolbox/" rel="nofollow">MCP Toolbox for Databases - Deploy to Cloud Run</a>, <a href="https://googleapis.github.io/genai-toolbox/how-to/deploy_gke/" rel="nofollow">Deploy to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE)</a>
- <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/mcp-support-for-apigee" rel="nofollow">Blog post - Announcing MCP support for Apigee</a> (Turnkey MCP hosting for Apigee-hosted APIs)
- “Tools Make an Agent” - <a href="https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/developers-practitioners/tools-make-an-agent-from-zero-to-assistant-with-adk" rel="nofollow">Blog</a> and <a href="https://codelabs.developers.google.com/codelabs/cloud-run/tools-make-an-agent" rel="nofollow">Codelab</a>
- Codelab - <a href="https://codelabs.developers.google.com/codelabs/cloud-run/how-to-deploy-a-secure-mcp-server-on-cloud-run#0" rel="nofollow">How to deploy a secure MCP server on Cloud Run</a>
- <a href="http://goo.gle/summoner" rel="nofollow">Codelab - "Agent Verse" - Architecting Multi-agent Systems</a>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">

## 🤝 Contributing

<a href="#-contributing" id="user-content--contributing" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: 🤝 Contributing"><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," class="octicon octicon-link" /></a>

</div>

We welcome contributions to this repository, including bug reports, feature requests, documentation improvements, and code contributions. Please see our [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/google/mcp/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started.
